title: Initialize Project Repository
acceptance_criteria: Git repository with main as default branch
README describes purpose, scope, prerequisites and architecture
gitignore excludes dependencies, build outputs, local settings and secrets
Initial directories separate app, contracts, docs and scripts
Branch convention feature/us-XXX-short-description documented
PR template includes US, changes, checks and acceptance criteria
License decision and versioning documented
Initial structure committed and pushed to main

title: Configure Desktop Application
acceptance_criteria: Electron desktop launches on macOS
Minimal Coffee Break welcome screen renders
Documented dev, typecheck, lint, test and build commands
Hot reload works for renderer changes
Strict TypeScript enabled
Reproducible dependency lockfile committed
Desktop and future connector responsibilities remain separate
Production application build succeeds

title: Establish Design System
acceptance_criteria: Reusable color, typography, spacing and radius tokens
Initial palette and typography documented
Desktop layout foundation exists
UI primitives use shared tokens
UI styling separate from Phaser art assets
Welcome screen demonstrates conventions
Usable at supported minimum window size
Guidelines cover agent status and interaction patterns

title: Define Application Architecture
acceptance_criteria: Major module responsibilities documented
Electron, UI and Connector boundaries documented
Provider-independent shared event contracts
Typed event envelope has id, type, timestamp, source and payload
Agent identity and lifecycle states defined
Provider normalization flow documented
Local data and security boundaries documented
Example provider event to state transition documented
Decisions and deferred concerns documented

title: Configure Codex Development Workflow
acceptance_criteria: Root AGENTS.md contains purpose, references, commands and conventions
YAGNI, minimal changes and reuse required
Skills stored in .agents/skills with SKILL.md
Architecture, UI, implementer, reviewer and testing skills exist
Each skill has purpose, activation and expected procedure/output
Instructions link docs rather than duplicate them
Implementer checks AC and dependencies before editing
Reviewer reports severity, evidence and correction
Hybrid testing guidelines documented
Representative implementer and reviewer exercise completed

title: Configure Continuous Integration
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions runs on PRs to main
Dependencies installed from committed lockfile
Typecheck failures fail workflow
Lint failures fail workflow
Test failures fail workflow
Build failures fail workflow
Least-privilege workflow permissions
Appropriate dependency caching
PR checks require no production credentials
Local equivalents documented
Successful PR run verified
Controlled failing check verified
